Jordan —

Thanks for the clear list. Short answers up front: we support both card auto-charge and monthly invoicing; Net30 is available with a PO and a brief credit setup (no heavy underwriting for most corporate customers). We also publish a rate card and offer tiered discounts for committed spend (annual and multi-quarter).

I've attached our current rate card (Redwood_RateCard_v3.pdf) and a PO template so your legal/finance team can see the required line items. High-level notes:

- Card (auto-charge): instant onboarding, no paperwork, best for small pilots.
- Monthly invoice (recommended for enterprise/procurement): requires a signed PO, we issue invoices monthly in arrears. Standard terms: Net30 from invoice date. Net45 available in special cases pending finance approval.
- Credit setup: we ask for a completed credit application for invoice terms > $50k/month; otherwise a PO and billing contact are sufficient.
- Discounts: 3% for 6mo commit, 5% for 12mo commit, larger discounts tied to committed spend thresholds.
- Onboarding fee: one-time $2,500 for enterprise onboarding + optional SSO/KMS integration fees if required.

Can you confirm Acme's preferred path (card vs invoice) and whether you expect to put a PO in place? If invoice, please share the legal name and billing address for the PO and any internal reference (SOW/CTR) we should include.

Thanks — happy to jump on a 20-min call if that helps speed this along.

Best,
Soojin Lee

Jordan —

Thanks — confirm we can proceed with monthly invoicing on Net30 with a PO. A few final clarifications to make purchasing easy:

1) Pilot invoicing: we can invoice actual usage for pilots up to $10,000/month with no minimum. If you expect > $10k/mo during pilot, we'll ask for a short-term commitment or refundable deposit (we'll discuss specifics if that looks likely).

2) Onboarding fee: $2,500 one-time; finance prefers a separate invoice for onboarding, due Net30. If you prefer we can amortize it into the first month's invoice — tell us which you prefer.

3) Discounts: standard 5% credit applied to invoices for customers who sign a 12-month committed-usage addendum. For the pilot stage we won't apply the commitment discount until a signed (12mo) agreement is in place.

4) Credit requirements: credit application only needed if expected spend > $50k/month. Otherwise PO + billing contact is sufficient.

Next steps: I've attached our PO template and a link to the rate card in case you want to circulate it. If this looks good, please send the PO with Acme's legal name and billing address and we'll confirm setup. I've cc'd Aditya (sales director) and Neha (finance) for visibility — they'll be available if procurement needs a quick call.
